import ctypes
import os

# Load the GSL libraries
ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

# Define the gsl_sf_psi_e function prototype
class GslSfResult(ctypes.Structure):
    _fields_ = [
        ("val", ctypes.c_double),
        ("err", ctypes.c_double)
    ]

gsl.gsl_sf_psi_e.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double, ctypes.POINTER(GslSfResult)]
gsl.gsl_sf_psi_e.restype = ctypes.c_int


def compute_digamma(x):
    result = GslSfResult()
    status = gsl.gsl_sf_psi_e(ctypes.c_double(x), ctypes.byref(result))
    if status != 0:
        raise ValueError("Error in computing digamma function")
    return result.val

    assert abs(compute_digamma(3.0) - 0.9227843350984671) < 1e-9, "Test case 3 failed"
